title: My Steam demo launches tomorrow, but I still need a few last-minute playtesters. Anyone want an early key?
author: I-want-to-say
selftext:
**Pluck Em!** is a pixel-art arcade shooter that mixes *Duck Hunt* with roguelite progression — and a growing number of increasingly angry birds.

The public demo launches on Steam tomorrow, but I’d love to get a few more people into the game beforehand to catch any last-minute bugs or balancing issues.

The game runs on **Windows, macOS and Steam Deck and it supports LIGHTGUNS!** There’s also an optional feedback survey inside the demo.

Comment below if you’d like an early Steam key. I have quite a few, so there should be enough to go around.

**Steam:**  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4859830/Pluck\_Em/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4859830/Pluck_Em/)
